svg.aria-label: Recruitor-AI — AI screening · full stack. An end-to-end AI screening pipeline: paste a job description, upload up to 50 CVs, and watch candidates scored across five dimensions and ranked live. It audits the shortlist for bias and writes 12 tailored interview questions per candidate. Built with JavaScript, Node.js, Express, React, PostgreSQL, SSE. POST /api/jd/parse · 50 CVs → pdf-parse + mammoth · score × 5 dimensions → SSE stream · bias audit on the shortlist · ✓ 12 interview questions each
